comment: The reason prefixes GET /api/tos/projection may emit, and the UI state each maps to. Shared by services/dashboard/routes/tos_projection.py's tests and strategy-builder-ui/src/lib/dashboard/tos.ts's tests. Both sides assert this file and both now run in CI: the Python side in .github/workflows/test.yml, the TS side in the job named "UI suite (lint + build + tsc + vitest)" in .github/workflows/ui.yml, which is path-gated on strategy-builder-ui/** and tests/fixtures/** and so runs whenever this file changes. Adding a prefix here without a matching projectionState branch therefore fails that job instead of landing in the UI as 'unknown'. That job is not a required check, so its red does not by itself block the merge button. No reason ever carries a value read from the projection file.
